app.name: ysk-mint
app.tagline: Guided multi-chain token launch. Native OFT. LP + lock. On-chain data only.

home.title: Launch an omnichain token in guided steps
home.body: Connect a wallet, deploy a LayerZero OFT, add liquidity, and lock LP. No backend — every number is read from the chain.
home.honesty: Contracts are not audited. Mainnet is disabled. Testnet only in this phase.

wallet.wrongNetwork: Switch to Base Sepolia or Arbitrum Sepolia.

wallet.need: Connect a wallet on Base Sepolia to continue.

chains.hint: Phase 1 only enables Base Sepolia. Other chains are listed but disabled.

omnichain.note: Select every testnet you want, then switch the wallet per chain during Execute. After all deploys, setPeer is called both ways. Cross-chain send stays 1:1 with no tax.
omnichain.addressNote: Token addresses are not the same across chains: the OFT implementation bakes in that chain’s LayerZero endpoint, so CREATE2 clones differ. The UI never pretends they match.

execute.needContracts: Factory / manager / locker / router addresses are still zero. Deploy the contracts on Base Sepolia and set packages/config/src/contracts.ts before a live mint.
execute.done: On-chain receipts saved. Continue to success.

success.title: Launch recorded on-chain
success.reread: Values below are live eth_call results, not the receipt cache.

token.missing: Pass a chainId and token address.

lock.missing: Pass a chainId and lock id.
